## Result: 1985, 1990 और 1996 — तीनों वर्षों में jailed समूह का wealth significantly lower है (कोई split decision नहीं)

### PRIMARY (crude unadjusted, सारे 12,013 rows, zeros retained)
Decision rule: Welch-asinh 1-sided **Holm p<.05** + Mann-Whitney 1-sided **Holm p<.05** + bootstrap (2000, stratified) mean-diff 95% CI का **upper bound < 0**.

| Year | mean jailed (n=289) | mean non-jailed (n=11,724) | **raw-dollar ratio** | median 1 vs 0 | Δ mean ($) [95% boot CI] | Welch t (df) | p_1s / **p_Holm** | MW **p_Holm** | **Hedges' g** | **Cliff's δ** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1985 | 7,929 | 25,086 | **0.32** (68.4% lower) | 720 vs 3,600 | −17,157 [−20,284, −13,695] | −5.24 (303.6) | 1.5e−07 / **1.5e−07** | **8.0e−11** | **−0.30** | **−0.22** |
| 1990 | 16,350 | 73,948 | **0.22** (77.9% lower) | 0 vs 10,500 | −57,598 [−67,275, −44,289] | −11.48 (302.4) | 7.5e−26 / **2.3e−25** | **1.2e−34** | **−0.68** | **−0.42** |
| 1996 | 20,383 | 105,447 | **0.19** (80.7% lower) | 0 vs 8,500 | −85,063 [−98,551, −65,962] | −10.37 (303.7) | 4.6e−22 / **9.2e−22** | **9.3e−26** | **−0.59** | **−0.35** |

**तीनों वर्ष = तीनों criterion pass (AGREE_all3 = True), split_decision_years = []** — कोई वर्ष direction-yes/track-no mismatch नहीं दिया, इसलिए कोई ambiguity छिपाने का प्रश्न नहीं उठता। Median-diff bootstrap CI भी तीनों वर्ष negative: 1985 −2,880 [−3,600, −2,300]; 1990 −10,500 [−11,100, −10,000]; 1996 −8,500 [−10,000, −7,140]। Hodges–Lehmann (asinh) −0.97 / −3.22 / −1.70।

### Statistical vs practical significance (आपका point #1)
n-ratio 1:40 होने के कारण छोटा gap भी significant आ सकता था — यहाँ gap छोटा नहीं है: jailed समूह का mean non-jailed का **सिर्फ़ 32%/22%/19%** है, median 1990 और 1996 में **शून्य** है, और jailed समूह का 45%/57%/63% लोगों sample के bottom decile में हैं बनाम 32%/29%/40%। Effect size small→large range में है: g = −0.30 (1985, small–medium), −0.68 (1990), −0.59 (1996); Cliff's δ = −0.22/−0.42/−0.35 (अर्थात यादृच्छिक रूप से चुना गया jailed व्यक्ति के कम wealth होने की संभावना ~61%/71%/68%)। यह magnitude-aware conclusion है, केवल p-based नहीं।

### SENSITIVITY — conclusion कहीं नहीं बदला (एक table, direction + pass/fail)
| Spec | 1985 | 1990 | 1996 | Direction lower? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 dedupe exact duplicates (n₁=239) | pass | pass | pass | हाँ (g −0.38/−0.84/−0.70) |
| S2 exclude zeros within-year (n₁=175/157/132) | pass | pass | pass | हाँ (g −0.20/−0.74/−0.91) |
| S3 winsorize 1st/99th | pass | pass | pass | हाँ (g −0.30/−0.69/−0.59) |
| S4 positive-only within-year (n₁=159/125/107) | pass | pass | pass | हाँ (g −0.38/−0.81/−0.88) |
| S5 extensive margin P(wealth>0) | RR 0.81, p=1.4e−03 | RR 0.61, p=8.1e−07 | RR 0.62, p=8.4e−05 | हाँ |

Bootstrap CI seed-stability (seeds 1/2/99): 1985 [−20.4k,−13.5k], 1990 [−67.8k,−44.1k], 1996 [−98.5k,−65.7k] — CI location ~0.5% भी नहीं हिला। ग़ौरतलब: **zeros हटाने से gap घटा नहीं, बल्कि effect size बड़ा हुआ** — यानी finding zero-coding artifact पर निर्भर नहीं करती।

### EXPLORATORY (side-by-side, primary को override नहीं करता)
- OLS on asinh wealth + sex + race (HC3): jailed coefficient −1.09 (p=2e−04), −3.38, −3.53 — तीनों वर्ष significant। Dollars-outcome OLS: −$9,441 / −$35,394 / −$60,911 (सब p<.001)। यानी crude gap_sex/race confounding से नहीं बन रहा (याद रखें: jailed समूह 87% male, 55% black)।
- Male-only (n_jailed=252): तीनों वर्ष significant।
- Race-stratified: white 1985/1990/1996 pass, hipanic तीनों pass, black 1990/1996 pass — **एकमात्र cell fail: black/1985 (est −0.30, p_Holm = 0.229, n_jailed=159)**। यह primary conclusion को नहीं बदलता, पर honest caveat है कि 1985 का gap black sub-sample में अकेले detect नहीं हुआ (power सीमित)।

### Final data-grounded hypothesis (deliverable)
"Individuals with a criminal record — operationalized here as `ever_jailed` = 1 (jailed at any time 1985–1994), the only criminal-record proxy in the supplied data — had significantly lower wealth than those without in **all three measured years: 1985, 1990, and 1996**. The wealth gap widened over time in relative terms (jailed mean = 32%, 22% and 19% of non-jailed means in 1985, 1990, 1996; Hedges' g = −0.30, −0.68, −0.59; one-sided Holm-adjusted p ≤ 1.5e−07 in every year), and it is not driven by duplicate rows, zero-coded wealth, top-coded outliers, or sex/race composition. **Timing caveat: 1985 and 1990 wealth is measured inside or adjacent to the 1985–1994 jail window, so those two gaps are consistent with pre-existing socioeconomic disadvantage and selection (reverse/ simultanous causality) rather than effects of incarceration; only 1996 is a clean post-window comparison**, so the causal reading should rest on 1996 while the descriptive answer to 'which years' remains 1985, 1990 and 1996."

### Declared assumptions (boldly, per your point #5–6)
1. **`ever_jailed` = "criminal record" — single operationalization.** कोई place-of-residence या formal-charge proxy supplied assets में नहीं है। इसका मतलब lifetime criminal records (arrests, convictions without jail, post-1994 incarceration) missing हैं; यह non-differential misclassification expected direction में **conservative** है (true offending group contaminated with unconvicted/never-caught people, जिससे gap underestimate होता है) — पर unmeasured-severity confounding नहीं ढकता।
2. Zero = genuine zero net worth in primary; zero-excluded spec sensitivity में (conclusion unchanged)।
3. **Unavailable और इसलिए assume नहीं किया गया:** NLSY79 sampling weights, respondent ID (dedupe की जाँच के अलावा कुछ नहीं), composite-wealth codebook (कौन-से five components, debt net होता है या नहीं), original analysis का test/threshold। ये unknowns unknown ही रखे गए — कोई reconstructed codebook/weighting नहीं बनाई।
4. 1,899 exact duplicate rows primary में retained; unweighted means nationally representative नहीं (NLSY79 minority/low-SES oversample)।
5. Nominal dollars; केवल within-year between-group comparison — कोई cross-year trend/inflation claim नहीं।

### Limitations
Cross-sectional per-year design, कोई covariate adjustment primary में नहीं (आपके निर्देशानुसार), n=289 subgroup power सीमित (black/1985 fail इसी का नतीजा), 25–38% exact zeros + शून्य missingness से zero-filled non-response की संभावना काटती नहीं (हालांकि exclude-zeros spec result नहीं बदलता), और jail window vs measurement-year overlap causal interpretation को 1996 तक सीमित कर देती है।
